phase_activation_evidence: Phase 1 is activation, months 1 through 3, the program begins and you'll see your first settlement offer.
phase_traction_evidence: Phase 2 is traction, months 4 through 9, that's when negotiations start and additional offers come in.
phase_momentum_evidence: Phase 3 is momentum, months 10 through 48 — that's the heart of the program where accounts resolve.
phase_graduation_evidence: And then graduation, month 48 plus, clean slate.
